proposition: Timurid-era sources present his grandfather, the philosopher Ṣadr al-Dīn Muḥammad b. Ḥabīb Allāh, as close to the Ilkhanid vizier Rashīd al-Dīn and an executor of his estate; the letters that document this are probably inauthentic and Timurid, and Ḥaydar Āmulī counted Ṣadr al-Dīn among his main sources.

mediation.who: Timurid-era sources and the Rashīd al-Dīn letters
mediation.note: MK asks why a 9th/15th-century Iran wanted this link posited
